title: The institutional opportunity
lead: Rugby is an institutional decision before it is an athletic one. Here is what it can do for a college.

pillars.title: Enrollment
pillars.body: Rugby opens a new population of prospective student-athletes an institution can actively recruit — many of whom would not otherwise apply.

pillars.title: Athletics
pillars.body: Adds a varsity offering and expands the institution's athletic portfolio, with one of the largest rosters in college sport.

pillars.title: Differentiation
pillars.body: Gives an institution another way to stand out in competitive recruiting markets — a program most peers do not offer.

pillars.title: Facilities
pillars.body: Rugby can share existing rectangular fields and athletic infrastructure rather than requiring a sport-specific build.

pillars.title: Student experience
pillars.body: Creates another structured community and competitive opportunity, supporting retention alongside recruitment.
